title: Llama with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a0e8ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='20' height='30' rx='6' fill='#e8b87a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='20' height='30' rx='6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='28' ry='16' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='26' ry='14' fill='#f7d79e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#d9a55e'/>
  <rect x='44' y='90' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d9a55e'/>
  <rect x='57' y='90' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d9a55e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#d9a55e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#f7d79e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='24' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(-18 35 24)' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='24' rx='4' ry='9' transform='rotate(18 65 24)' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='24' rx='2' ry='6' transform='rotate(-18 35 24)' fill='#ffd9d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='24' rx='2' ry='6' transform='rotate(18 65 24)' fill='#ffd9d9'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M44 20 Q46 10 50 14 Q54 8 56 20' fill='#f2c98a' stroke='#e8b87a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffeac2'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='43' rx='1.1' ry='1.5' fill='#c98a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='43' rx='1.1' ry='1.5' fill='#c98a4a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 49 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#c98a4a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2a6fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2a6fb0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='32.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='35.5' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='35.5' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around eyes -->
  <path d='M33 29 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1-2.5 l-2.5-1 l2.5-1 z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
  <path d='M67 29 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1-2.5 l-2.5-1 l2.5-1 z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
  <path d='M50 22 l0.8 2 l2 0.8 l-2 0.8 l-0.8 2 l-0.8-2 l-2-0.8 l2-0.8 z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
  <!-- cheecks -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='41' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='41' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
